SELECT bj AS class, bj AS class_name, xx AS school_name, exam_name,
       anon_stu_id AS student_id, dq AS district, xkkm,
       sx AS score, 150 AS exam_score
FROM tb_score_overview
WHERE xx LIKE '%扬州中学%'
  AND xsxz = '在籍生'
  AND sx IS NOT NULL AND sx > 0
  AND bj IS NOT NULL AND CAST(bj AS TEXT) <> ''
 AND exam_name LIKE '%2026届高三1月期末%'ORDER BY exam_name DESC, bj
LIMIT 50000
